The '''Wraith''' was a modified [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] owned by [[Narra Mesyne]]. Working undercover as "Miraj", Mesyne competed in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]] on [[Stend VI]].<ref name="WHSV" />
